### Summary

Robotics PhD candidate in Dr. Samuel Coogan's FACTS Lab at Georgia Tech and AI for Autonomy intern at Sandia National Laboratories, specializing in safe autonomy, reinforcement learning, and real-time control. Proven track record of developing and deploying safe, computationally efficient planning and control methods for autonomous systems. At Sandia, built a kinetic-intercept benchmark suite for the U.S. government, approved for Unclassified Unlimited Release and submitted to ICRA 2027, and designed a new intercept control law benchmarked against guidance-law, NMPC, and reinforcement-learning methods. Selected to the U.S. Department of State's Fulbright Specialist Roster after spearheading an international research collaboration with Lactec, a Brazilian partner institution, that is bringing research funding to Georgia Tech. Author of 4 peer-reviewed publications, 3 as first author, in venues including IEEE TCST and ACC, with 3 more under review.
